---
title: "Leaderboards"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
---

Track seasonal leaders with sortable tables. Use the filters to focus on a specific season and round, and the minimum matches threshold to control when per-match rates appear.

```{ojs}
const raw = await FileAttachment("data/match_stats.csv").csv({typed: true});

const data = raw.map((d) => ({
  match_id: d["\ufeffmatch_id"] ?? d.match_id ?? "",
  Season: d.Season?.toString() ?? "",
  Round: d.Round?.toString() ?? "",
  Player: d.Player ?? "",
  Aces: Number(d.Aces) || 0,
  Winners: Number(d.Winners) || 0,
  ErrorsForced: Number(d["Errors Forced"]) || 0,
  UnforcedErrors: Number(d["Unforced Errors"]) || 0,
  MVPVotes: Number(d["MVP Votes"]) || 0
})).filter((d) => d.Player);

const seasonValues = Array.from(new Set(data.map((d) => d.Season).filter(Boolean)))
  .sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
const roundValues = Array.from(new Set(data.map((d) => d.Round).filter(Boolean)))
  .sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b));
```

```{ojs}
viewof season = Inputs.select(["All", ...seasonValues], {
  label: "Season",
  value: "All"
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof round = Inputs.select(["All", ...roundValues], {
  label: "Round",
  value: "All"
})
```

```{ojs}
viewof minMatches = Inputs.range([1, 10], {
  label: "Minimum matches for per-match rates",
  step: 1,
  value: 3
})
```

```{ojs}
const filtered = data.filter((d) =>
  (season === "All" || d.Season === season) &&
  (round === "All" || d.Round === round)
);

function buildLeaderboard(rows, statKey) {
  const grouped = d3.rollup(
    rows,
    (v) => ({
      matches: v.length,
      total: d3.sum(v, (row) => row[statKey])
    }),
    (row) => row.Player
  );

  return Array.from(grouped, ([player, stats]) => {
    const perMatch = stats.matches >= minMatches ? stats.total / stats.matches : null;
    return {
      Player: player,
      Matches: stats.matches,
      Total: stats.total,
      "Per Match": perMatch
    };
  }).sort((a, b) => {
    if (b.Total !== a.Total) return b.Total - a.Total;
    return (b["Per Match"] ?? -Infinity) - (a["Per Match"] ?? -Infinity);
  });
}

function leaderboardTable(rows) {
  return Inputs.table(rows, {
    columns: ["Player", "Matches", "Total", "Per Match"],
    sort: "Total",
    reverse: true,
    format: {
      "Per Match": (value) => (value == null ? "—" : value.toFixed(2))
    }
  });
}

const mvpLeaderboard = buildLeaderboard(filtered, "MVPVotes");
const acesLeaderboard = buildLeaderboard(filtered, "Aces");
const winnersLeaderboard = buildLeaderboard(filtered, "Winners");
const errorsForcedLeaderboard = buildLeaderboard(filtered, "ErrorsForced");
const unforcedErrorsLeaderboard = buildLeaderboard(filtered, "UnforcedErrors");
```

## MVP votes

```{ojs}
leaderboardTable(mvpLeaderboard)
```

## Aces

```{ojs}
leaderboardTable(acesLeaderboard)
```
